title: Async/Await Check
description: Predict await resume order and try/catch around await.

questions.explanation: `main()` runs synchronously until `await`, printing `A`. Then `C` runs. `B` resumes later as a microtask.

questions.prompt: What does an `async` function always return?
questions.explanation: An `async` function always returns a Promise, even if you `return` a plain value.

questions.prompt: How does `await` on a rejected Promise behave inside an `async` function?

options.text: It converts the rejection into a timer task

questions.explanation: `await` on a rejection throws inside the async function. Catch it with `try/catch` (or handle the returned Promise).

options.text: Immediate sync work ahead of `console.log` in the caller

questions.explanation: `await` pauses the async function and schedules the continuation as a microtask after the awaited Promise settles.
